title: Fix two simple bugs in Go HTTP handler: wrong status code and wrong response key
description: A Go HTTP handler returns HTTP 201 instead of 200, and uses 'data' instead of 'items' as the JSON response key. Both bugs break the existing test.

task_spec.prompt:
The Go handler in internal/handler/items.go has two bugs introduced by a bad commit:

Bug 1 — wrong status code: The handler calls w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated) explicitly, causing GET /items to return HTTP 201 instead of 200. Remove that line.

Bug 2 — wrong response key: The JSON response uses 'data' instead of 'items'. Change the key back to 'items'.

After fixing both bugs, go test ./... must show 1/1 tests passing.
success_criteria: Both fixes are minimal — change only what is broken
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
